input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on Northwind. Clause 12.3 affirmatively confirms the preferred position: Customer is free to develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and conduct business in any field or territory, and has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. Clause 12.4 runs the other way — it restrains Vendor from developing or marketing a service competing with Customer's analytics products during the term — which benefits us and is not flagged. The Section 13 licence terms (13.4) are ordinary use restrictions on the Services themselves (no reverse engineering, no interference, no unlawful use), not restraints on Customer's business lines, and 13.1 grants a worldwide, non-exclusive right without field-of-use limits. Sections 2, 26 and 30 impose no purchase commitment or restraint. Preferred position met; no redline.
